def __init__(
    self,
    enable_testing: bool = False,
    graphai_version: str = "0.5",
    use_llm_generation: bool = True,
    engine: str = "taskflow",  # Issue #350
) -> None:
    """Initialize WorkflowGenWorkflow.
    
    Args:
        enable_testing: Whether to run workflow tests
        graphai_version: GraphAI version for YAML
        use_llm_generation: Whether to use LLM-based generation
        engine: Workflow engine ('taskflow' or 'graphai') - Issue #350
    """
    from .engine_strategy import create_strategy
    
    self._enable_testing = enable_testing
    self._graphai_version = graphai_version
    self._use_llm_generation = use_llm_generation
    self._engine = engine
    
    # Issue #350: Create strategy based on engine type
    self._strategy = create_strategy(engine)

critical_gaps.title: Strategy Pattern Not Integrated into WorkflowGenWorkflow
critical_gaps.description: The entire Strategy Pattern implementation (create_strategy, TaskFlowGeneratorStrategy, GraphAIGeneratorStrategy) is DEAD CODE because workflow.py never calls create_strategy(). WorkflowGenWorkflow.__init__ does not have engine parameter and does not instantiate any strategy.
critical_gaps.impact: Engine switching is completely non-functional. Users cannot switch between TaskFlow and GraphAI engines.
critical_gaps.root_cause: Implementation stopped at defining classes but did not integrate them into the workflow execution path
critical_gaps.fix_required: Add engine parameter to WorkflowGenWorkflow.__init__, call create_strategy(engine), and use self._strategy.generate() instead of direct LLM calls
critical_gaps.estimated_effort: 2-3 hours (modify workflow.py, update orchestrator, add tests)

notes: CRITICAL FINDING: The Strategy Pattern is completely dead code. workflow.py never calls create_strategy().
WorkflowGenWorkflow.__init__ does NOT have engine parameter (line 62-83).
WorkflowGenWorkflow.execute() does NOT use any strategy - it directly calls YamlGeneratorSubWorkflow (line 140-143).
All strategy classes (F2, F3, F4) are defined but never instantiated in production code.
TaskFlowLLMGenerator (F5) works correctly when called but is only used via TaskFlowGeneratorStrategy which is never instantiated.
The implementation has excellent test coverage for individual components but ZERO integration.
This is a classic example of TDD without E2E verification - all unit tests pass but feature doesn't work.
Feature F12 (TASKFLOW_ERROR_MESSAGES) is a documentation error - the actual implementation uses _TASKFLOW_ERROR_MESSAGES (private) accessed via get_error_message() function, which is correct.
All schema classes (F6, F7) and validators (F9, F10) are properly integrated within their modules.
All constants and enums (F11, F13, F14) are properly used in their respective modules.
The root cause is Gap G1 - once create_strategy() is called from workflow.py, the entire strategy pattern will activate.
